description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeysCapabilities class, specifically testing support for different key systems, their versions, and support status, using Google Test framework. It mocks dependencies like OcdmFactory, OcdmSystemFactory, and OcdmMock to verify behavior.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCapabilitiesKeySystemsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for MediaKeysCapabilities, setting up mocks and common test data.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Tests that getSupportedKeySystems returns the correct list of supported key systems based on mock responses.

methods.name: DoesSupportKeySystem
methods.description: Tests that supportsKeySystem returns true when the key system is supported.

methods.name: DoesNotSupportKeySystem
methods.description: Tests that supportsKeySystem returns false when the key system is not supported.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionSuccess
methods.description: Verifies that getSupportedKeySystemVersion returns true and sets the version string when creation and getVersion succeed.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionOcdmSystemFailure
methods.description: Verifies that getSupportedKeySystemVersion returns false and empty version when createOcdmSystem returns nullptr.

methods.name: GetSupportedKeySystemVersionGetVersionFailure
methods.description: Verifies that getSupportedKeySystemVersion returns false and empty version when getVersion fails.
